Seals/Logos The use of the Board seals, logos and other official insignia is protected by federal law and may not be used or reproduced without the Board's written permission. In addition, federal law (18 U.S.C. § 709) prohibits the unauthorized use of the words 'Federal Reserve" or the sign or symbol of the Board or Federal Reserve in a manner calculated to convey the impression that a nonmember bank, banking association, firm or partnership is a member of the Federal Reserve System. Disclaimer for FRB U.S. Model and the Estimated Dynamic Optimization (EDO) Model This disclaimer applies to the FRB U.S. Model and the Estimated Dynamic Optimization (EDO) Model (the Models). While the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (the Board) has verified the accuracy of the Models in connection with the Board's use in the Board's publications, the Models should be used by others only with appropriate caution. The Board is providing the Models, including the numerical data and formulas contained in the Models, solely for the purpose of illustrating the modelling framework for projecting possible outcomes under different scenarios. The Board may periodically publish updates to the Models on its website at www.federalreserve.gov . As the User, you assume the entire risk related to your use of the Models, including your use of any updates to the Models. The Board is providing the Models "as is" and the Board disclaims any all warranties, express or implied, including without limitation any implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purposes. In no event will the Board be liable to you or to any third party for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special or exemplary damages or lost profit related to the Models, including, but not limited to, the installation or attempt to install the Models, the use or inability to use the Models, the use of data embodied in or obtained from the Models, or the use of any input data, documentation or other materials accompanying the Models. Therefore, Users should rely on the User's own inquiries as to the accuracy and relevance of the data incorporated into or applicable to the Models; not use the Models, including the output, as the basis for making any decision or embarking on any course of action; and be aware that the data contained in the Models and the output of the Models should not be regarded as representative of any current data or forecasts of what will happen under a given set of conditions. Users may not use or modify the Models and then present them as official government material. Disclaimer for Interactive Data Visualizations This disclaimer applies to the Interactive Data Visualizations available for the Financial Accounts of the United States – Z.1 and Enhanced Financial Accounts (EFA) – as well as the Survey of Consumer Finances (SCF) and the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (SHED), which are the official releases. The Interactive Data Visualizations are provided solely to assist Users with a visual representation of the data and do not modify or otherwise change the official releases. Content within the Interactive Data Visualizations will be updated only after the publication of the Financial Accounts of the United States – Z.1 and EFA releases, the SCF, and the SHED. Any corrections to data will be published to the official release before it is reflected in the corresponding Interactive Data Visualizations. Should any discrepancy exist between the data contained in the official release and the Interactive Data Visualizations, Users should consult the official release for the correct data. To access Interactive Data Visualizations, Users must have JavaScript enabled within their browsers. Disclaimer for Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) and Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) APIs BEA: These data are BEA data. Data were accessed and retrieved using the BEA API. This product uses the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) Data API but is not endorsed or certified by BEA. BLS: These data are BLS data. Data were accessed and retrieved using the BLS API. BLS.gov cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from BLS.gov. Data are updated generally at 8:30 a.m. on the day of release. However, there may be a lag between when updated BEA or BLS data are released, and when the data are updated on the Board's website.
